name: smwmusic-endless-determination
title: Endless Determination
description:
My first remix of my own composition (or I guess technically you can call this it's own composition, in which case, this is the fifth finished one).

After re-listening to Endless Nights I wondered if I can make it more boss battle themed and the result was this!

Some parts were from compositions that didn't go anywhere, like the intro, so I reused them, since they fit well here.

Was made to be used in boss battles, but I could also see its use in chase levels or intense castles with lasers.
